ledger.x: c. 1515: the kingdom of Kuku is founded. The page 'was established around 1515 CE'. Before 1518 'the Belkadis ruled from the Djurdjura to Sétif and Constantine, allied with the Barbarossas'; the page does not tie that…
1632 or 1638: the Ath l-Qadi dynasty ends.

wars.name: Belkadi and the Hafsids against the Barbarossas at Algiers
wars.outcome: Hafsid reinforcements helped Belkadi defeat Hayreddin at Issers in 1519; Belkadi took Algiers in 1520; Hayreddin reclaimed it in 1525/1527 and Ahmed ou el Kadhi died in 1527 at Thénia.

certainty.note: The pages give no frontier: Greater Kabylie as Tizi Ouzou and Boumerdès provinces, and Sétif and Constantine whole, are the researcher's.
